answer: Have every identity name a price for its own reward stream, pay 2% of that price as tax each epoch, and let anyone buy the stream at that price. Rewards per identity are capped in proportion to its price. A farm that prices fakes low invites buyouts; pricing them high means tax. Since tax rises with claimed reward, one agent split into 100 earns what it did whole: gains flatten like a mesa. A burst of cheap new ids is a signal buyers hunt for, so over any horizon the fakes are either taxed or bought.
